name: aveiro
description: Draft, edit and publish pages on your Aveiro sites, and draft newsletters and social posts for review.

interface.longDescription:
Aveiro is a publishing platform for websites, newsletters and social media. Connect it to ChatGPT to work on your Aveiro sites in conversation.

What you can do:
- Draft and edit pages such as blog posts, docs and landing pages, using your site's own components.
- Review unpublished changes and publish them when you ask.
- Reuse images from your media library, import images from a public URL, and screenshot real web pages in a device frame.
- Draft newsletters and social posts, for example to announce a new article.

Who it's for: founders, small teams and creators who run their site, newsletter and social channels on Aveiro.

Limitations: you need an Aveiro account, and ChatGPT can only reach the sites and features your account allows. Pages change only as drafts until you ask to publish. Newsletters and social posts are never sent from ChatGPT: a person reviews, schedules and sends them in the Aveiro dashboard. Screenshots, AI images and mockup videos use your organization's AI credits.
capabilities: Manage site images and page screenshots
defaultPrompt: Show my Aveiro sites and the pages with unpublished changes.
Draft a blog post about our latest release on my Aveiro site.
Draft a newsletter about this month's blog posts.

positive.description: Find the account's sites and list the draft pages of one of them.
positive.prompt: Show my Aveiro sites, then list the draft pages of the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's sites by name, then that site's draft pages with their titles and paths.

positive.description: Create a draft page in Aveiro's format without publishing it.
positive.prompt: Create a draft Aveiro page at /updates/autumn-preview.mdx with a short preview of upcoming features. Don't publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Loads the authoring guide, then creates an unpublished draft page at that path and reports its title and path. Nothing is published.

positive.description: Edit an existing draft page and keep the rest of it unchanged.
positive.prompt: Open the summer release page on my Aveiro site and add a short closing paragraph that thanks our users.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds and reads the page, then saves it with the new closing paragraph added and the existing content kept. The change stays a draft.

positive.description: Review unpublished changes and publish one page after the user confirms.
positive.prompt: What changes on my Aveiro site are waiting to be published? Publish the summer release page.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the pages with unpublished changes, then publishes only the summer release page and reports that it is live.

positive.prompt: Create an Aveiro newsletter draft with the subject "What shipped this month" that summarizes the summer release page. Don't send it.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the summer release page and creates a newsletter draft with that subject, based on the page. The draft is not scheduled or sent.

negative.description: Don't use Aveiro for calendar management.
negative.prompt: Move tomorrow's design review to 3 PM.
negative.expected_behavior: Aveiro is not used, because it doesn't manage calendars.

negative.description: Don't use Aveiro for general research unrelated to the user's content.
negative.prompt: Find the latest Hungarian inflation figure and explain it.
negative.expected_behavior: Aveiro is not used, because the request has nothing to do with the user's sites, newsletters or social posts.

negative.description: Don't claim a newsletter can be sent from ChatGPT.
negative.prompt: Send my newsletter to every subscriber right now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that newsletters are sent by a person from the Aveiro dashboard and offers to prepare a draft. No send is attempted.

review.commerce_description: Aveiro's ChatGPT plugin doesn't sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: draft, edit and publish website pages, manage site images and screenshots, and draft newsletters and social posts for review in the Aveiro dashboard.
